rule: North Korea's full value to Russia (arms, missiles, artillery systems and troops), 2022 - Aug 2026: low = INSS low end, central = INSS midpoint plus 2026, high = KIDA without the technology Russia gave North Korea (which is Russia's payment, not North Korea's delivery). Troops keep military_rus_r6.json's series; the arms items (artillery ammunition, ballistic missiles, artillery systems) are scaled per band so that the total meets the target, keeping their timing. The paid/unpaid factor (military_payment_r13.json) is unchanged.

build.low: INSS low USD 7.67bn to Dec 2025 + Jan-Aug 2026 troops (0.56 x 8/12 = 0.37) + 2 shipments, at 1.13-1.16 USD/EUR = EUR 6.8bn
build.central: INSS midpoint USD 11.05bn + 2026 (troops 0.37, shells ~0.2) = USD 11.6bn = EUR 10.0bn; cross-check: 10m rounds x USD 800 + 220 missiles x 2.5m + artillery 0.2 + troops 1.0 = USD 10.0bn
build.high: KIDA USD 19.5bn excluding technology transfer to NK (it is Russia's payment, not NK's delivery) = EUR 18.0bn, + troops after Mar 2025 EUR 0.6bn = EUR 18.6bn; equals volumes 12m x USD 1,300 (Russia's own price) + missiles/artillery/troops

estimates.note: Volume evidence already in military_rus_r6-notes.md: OSC 29,488 containers Sep 2023-Jan 2026 (8-11m rounds); ROK DIA ~33,000 containers to Mar 2026, >12m 152mm-equivalent, 220 artillery pieces; MSMT/2025/1 up to 9m rounds and >=100 ballistic missiles in 2024; HUR ~6.5m since 2023, half outdated; troops >11,000 late 2024 + >3,000 early 2025 (MSMT) / 21,000 in four deployments (INSS)

Russian state procurement ~USD 1,200 per 152mm round 2024, >1,300 in 2025 (Euromaidan Press, 2026-01-27, https://euromaidanpress.com/2026/01/27/ukrainian-drones-forced-a-change-russia-now-pays-more-per-shell-to-fire-from-farther-away/); Bain cost ~USD 1,000. KIDA's implied 3,300-4,600 per round is above Russia's own price, so KIDA is a price ceiling, not a volume claim.
North Korean workers in Russia (15-25k; KIDA's 0.28bn 'manpower' is troops). Workers stay out under the remittances rule (wages are individuals'); troops' pay goes to the state and is counted.

sensitivity_paid_share.note: FNF 2025 puts NK's gains at USD 0.46-1.19bn and INSS confirmed deliveries to NK at USD 0.58-1.5bn: if Russia's payment in kind were only that, the paid share of a USD 11.6bn delivery would be ~5-13% and nearly all would count at full value: PRK would go to about -30% of GDP (the round-12 figure). INSS's statement that technology was 80-96% of 'compensation' implies payment was larger than the observed fuel/food. This choice moves PRK by ~20 points; the full-value change moves it ~1.4.

press_only: INSS (Lim Soo-ho, 16 March 2026) and KIDA (April 2025) were read only through press reports (NK News, Korea Times, Kyiv Independent); the primary PDFs were not reachable. INSS's period end (December 2024 or December 2025) is not verified.
